text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Run with Flash again? Hmm... What 
should I do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after returning from the trip, I 
went to ask Mr. C.B. for a rematch, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Right after the Derby, it might have been 
fun, but...
choice_data_list: I like her a lot more like this.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? You sound pretty confident.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Then entertain me, would you? —Right this 
second!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then... same as last time: 2,400 meters, 
counter-clockwise.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Understood. Well then, I'm counting on ya~

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Please give me your advice.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since it was decided that I'd run 
against her again, I haven't been able to 
envision a path to victory at all."
choice_data_list: Yeah, I might actually lose, huh...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh... Um, Trainer...?
choice_data_list:
Still, you've always turned your setbacks 
into weapons.

Still, you've always turned your setbacks 
into weapons.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was losing to Mr. C.B. last time that 
made her realize her own desire to win."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Using that drive as momentum to challenge 
her ideals... she produced results."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What happened with the Kikuka Sho was, in 
a way, a setback. Thanks to that, she 
learned how to face forward— and went on 
to battle tough rivals in the Japan Cup 
and Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Growing through repeated failures, 
reaching closer and closer toward 
"perfection."
choice_data_list: I'm so proud of who you are now.
I'm so proud of you as you are now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list:
Believe in yourself, the one who worked 
harder than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"So just go ahead and do whatever you 
want♪ If it's you, Flash-san, you can do 
anything!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I still feel like I might lose. 
Whenever someone corners me in the final 
100 meters...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However... with how I am now, I choose to 
believe... I can pull ahead in the final 
10 meters.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Are you ready? Shall we get started?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Looks like today... you'll be 
focusing solely on me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Well, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Just focus on the race right in front of 
me... Just run... like I always do...!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'll believe—in myself...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh? My legs feel light. I can see 
CB-san's movements so clearly, too...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (—I can do this!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Heh... Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Th-That was close~. It almost got away!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I ended up getting caught. However...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You unleashed your late-race burst at the 
perfect time. That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Man, that really fired me up for the first 
time in a while. It was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Seeing our juniors grow up really does 
make me happy...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do this again, Flash! —Someday, on 
the racetrack!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After parting ways with Mr. C.B....
choice_data_list:
Looks like all that sticking to the 
schedule has paid off

Looks like all that sticking to the 
schedule has paid off, huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
... I... had lost sight of myself, hadn't 
I?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I was terrified... and began to lose faith 
in everything I had built up until now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Under the pretty guise of being 
"flexible," I ran away from confronting it 
head-on.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yet today, my legs felt remarkably light. 
...Even though they used to feel heavy as 
mud.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Your words gave me the strength to push 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I had... grown stronger. It had all been 
building up, hadn't it?
choice_data_list:
Every second you've accumulated is your 
weapon.

Every single second you've built up is 
your greatest weapon.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, please tell me. Supposing we 
didn't change the schedule—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Do you think... even as I am right now, I 
can show my parents a figure they can be 
proud of?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Rather than vague emotional appeals, 
she presented evidence that convinced me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Then I have no choice but to believe. 
Believe in myself... and everything I've 
done so far."
choice_data_list:
Let's show your parents how you stand tall 
with pride.

Let's show your parents how you stand tall 
with pride.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will challenge them. No matter what kind 
of formidable rival I face—!
